note: The D0 falsifier mutation table (PLAN-00 acceptance 3). Mechanical, named mutations on the pinned tree; oldText is unique in its file — scripts/depth-probe.ts refuses a missing or non-unique match rather than guessing. expectedTier is the tier whose assertions SHOULD be the ones that catch it, per the PLAN-00 tier table; a catch by a different tier is a finding. The two control mutations must stay green: a red control means the probe is noisy. The suite is generated once from the UNMUTATED tree and never regenerated between mutations.
